title: LIST OF GALLANTRY AWARDS AND MENTION IN DESPATCHES TO INDIAN AIR FORCE PERSONNEL APPROVED BY SMT. DROUPADI MURMU ON THE EVE OF INDEPENDENCE DAY 2026
body_text:
President Smt. Droupadi Murmu , has approved the following awards to the Indian Air Force personnel on the eve of Independence Day 2026.
DETAIL OF AWARDEES
Shaurya Chakra.pdf
Vayu Sena Medal (Gallantry).pdf
Mention-in-Despatches.pdf
***
JS/VK/SM

enrichment.summary: On the eve of Independence Day 2026, President Droupadi Murmu approved gallantry awards for Indian Air Force personnel, including Shaurya Chakra, Vayu Sena Medal (Gallantry), and Mention-in-Despatches. The PIB release lists these award categories with detailed awardee names provided in linked PDF documents, without additional numbers or narrative in the main text.
enrichment.context: Gallantry awards such as the Shaurya Chakra and Vayu Sena Medal (Gallantry) are part of India's system of honouring acts of valour and distinguished service by defence personnel, typically announced on Independence Day and Republic Day. The Shaurya Chakra is a peacetime gallantry award, ranking below the Ashoka Chakra and Kirti Chakra, while the Vayu Sena Medal is specific to the Indian Air Force for acts of gallantry or distinguished service. Mention-in-Despatches recognizes gallant or meritorious action but is a lesser honour than a formal medal. These announcements are routine biannual events and, while important for military tradition and personnel recognition, do not typically carry policy or governance significance for a general current-affairs syllabus.
